Calculate PSD and POC flux for the 2021 and 2023 data
This uses the _PAR_Aggregated files from Ecopart.

The POC calculation scripts here copy the Matlab functions in the file processPocFluxFromUvp.m associated with the Rufas et al. (2025) GRL paper. Some lines and functions were recoded to follow R conventions.
https://github.com/annarufas/Rufas_etal_2024_GRL/blob/master/code/processPocFluxFromUvp.m

The methods explained in Rufas et al. 2025 adapting the Bisson et al. 2022 approach of the truncated power law. In the truncated power law model in Bisson et al. (2022), the modelled particle count is lower for larger particles (stronger decrease with higher lambda). 

Note that seasonal variation in POC flux is expected based on the results in the Rufas et al. 2025 aggregation (i.e., decrease in flux post-bloom).


Additionally, a MC Error propagation can be applied to account for the uncertainty in the sampling volume simular to Rufas et al. 2025.

Note that for UVP5, in Barth and Stone (2022), they removed the bottom 50m of each profile because they observed that the slowing of the CTD-rosette leads to high potential reimaging of particles.


```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


# Load libraries and functions 
for calculating and modeling the POC flux at each depth
The PSD is based on the LPM (large particulate material) concentrations (# L-1) by size classes.
- In the calculatePocFlux function: the psd and binMiddle inputs are arrays for each depth bin. The zeros are not removed since these are summed.
- In the calculateModelledPsd: observedVol is a single value, and observedN/binWidth/binMiddle are arrays

alpha: particle dominance (smaller value, larger particles dominate)
lambda: the particle size (mm) where power law is truncated
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
# library(stats)

theme_set(theme_bw())
`%notin%` <- Negate(`%in%`)


# This is power law based model (Kiko et al. 2017)
calculatePOCFlux <- function(psd, binMiddle, binWidth) {
  particleEsd <- binMiddle

  # A = 2.8, b = 2.24 (used in Bisson et al. 2022)
  fluxFactor <- function(d) 2.8 * d^2.24

  pocFlux <- sum((psd/binWidth) * fluxFactor(particleEsd)*binWidth, na.rm = TRUE)

  return(pocFlux)
}

# For the truncated power law method in Bisson et al. (2022)
# NOTE observedN is the concentration * volume sampled
calculateModelledPsd <- function(observedN, observedVol, binWidth, binMiddle) {
  # Modelled particle number (# part./um), Eq. 1 in Bisson et al. (2022)
  modelledN <- function(x, d) {
    x[1] * d^-x[2] * exp(-d / x[3])
  }
  
  # log10 transform observedN and divide by bin width
  observedN_log10 <- log10(observedN / binWidth)
  observedN_log10 <- unlist(observedN_log10)
  
  # Only consider populated size classes and remove the ones that are not
  bad <- which(is.infinite(observedN_log10))
  observedN_log10_good <- observedN_log10[-bad]
  binMiddle_good <- binMiddle[-bad]
  
  # Initial guess and bounds for model parameters
  # PP: Originally, x0 is c(40, 4, 0.1) but I changed it to c(10, 4, 0.1) to reduce the warning "Error at i = ___ :  L-BFGS-B needs finite values of 'fn'"
  #       C1    alpha lambda
  x0 <- c(10, 4, 0.1) # part L-1 / unitless / mm
  lower <- c(-Inf, 0, min(binMiddle_good))
  upper <- c(Inf, 6, max(binMiddle_good))
  
  # PP: In the original code, this is the fminsearchbnd() Matlab function.
  # Optimise model parameters using optim with box constraints (L-BFGS-B)
  opt <- stats::optim(
    par = x0,
    fn = function(x) {
      sum((observedN_log10_good - log10(modelledN(x, binMiddle_good)))^2)
    },
    method = "L-BFGS-B", 
    lower = lower,
    upper = upper
  )
  
  C1 <- opt$par[1]
  alpha <- opt$par[2]
  lambda <- opt$par[3]
  
  estimNbl <- (modelledN(opt$par, binMiddle) / observedVol) * binWidth
  
  # Remove particle size classes that are not in the observed set
  estimNbl[bad] <- NA
  
  list(estimNbl = estimNbl, C1 = C1, alpha = alpha, lambda = lambda)
}
```


# *** NEW UVP6 POC Calculation ***
May 15, 2026: Filter profiles first then, average particle concentrations in 20 m bins. Use truncated power law function to model the particle concentrations.

From the modelled particle concentrations, calculate the NBSS and the POC flux. From the POC flux, calculate the Martin's b curve.
## POC Flux
```{r}
load("data/UVP6_ECOPART_Data_20260320.RData") 

## Establish the size class bins and bin width
bins <- uvp6_par_cnames %>% 
  filter(grepl("concentration", AnnotatedColumnName)) %>% 
  filter(Lower_limit_um >= 128 & Lower_limit_um < 16400) %>% # to match the 0.14-16.88 mm size range in Kiko et al. (2017) and Bisson et al. (2022)
    # calculate the midpoint as the geometric mean instead
  mutate(Size_class_midpoint_mm = sqrt(Lower_limit_um * Upper_limit_um)/1000)
  
colStart <- which(uvp6_par_cnames$Lower_limit_um == 128)[1]-17
colEnd <- which(uvp6_par_cnames$Lower_limit_um == 13000)[1]-17

# number of bins
UVP6_N_sizebins <- nrow(bins)
# Get width of size bins
UVP6_sizebins_width <- bins$Size_class_width_mm
# Get midpoints of size bins
UVP6_sizebins_mid <- bins$Size_class_midpoint_mm


# For Station_year and region metadata
load("data/uvp6_images_calculated_traits_20260321.RData")
rm(indiv_traits, region_rename, volumes.df)
clrs <- c("firebrick","#FF6800","#FFB300","forestgreen", "blue1","purple2","#F6768E")

# Outlier profiles to exclude
to_exclude_200 <- c("AC20 2023","NaresW23 2023","NaresE23 2023",
                "RA38 2024", "RA06 2024", "RA07 2024", "RA08 2024", "RA31 2024",
                "RA42 2024", "RA43 2024", "RA73 2024", 
                "Kangalasiorvik Shelf 2024",
                "TCA-QFA1 2024", "de500 2021",
                "keb_S05 2024","RA72 2024","RA02 2024","RA52 2024")

to_exclude_500 <- c("RA46 2024", "RA48 2024", "RA50 2024", "RA45 2024",
                    "RA03 2024", "RA49 2024", "RA51 2024",
                    "TCAT6-03(A3) 2024", "129 2023",
                    "Sentinel 2024", "LSea-23 2023")

# Particle concentrations
particle.conc <- uvp6_PAR[, c(1,6,7,colStart:colEnd)] %>% 
  # Curate profiles (only include profiles part of the LPC flux calculation)
  left_join(Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
              select(sample_id, station_year, reg.inuk, bottom_depth_m), 
            by = join_by(sample_id)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(station_year)) %>% 
  filter(Depth_5m > 10) %>% 
  filter(station_year %notin% to_exclude_200) %>% 
  # Exclude depth bins 50 m  above the bottom depth (Barth and Stone 2022)
  filter(Depth_5m <= bottom_depth_m-50) %>% 
  # Calculate the observed particle concentrations by size classes per 20m bins and for each station_year
  mutate(Depth_bin = round(Depth_5m / 20) * 20) %>% 
  group_by(station_year, reg.inuk, Depth_bin) %>% 
  summarise(n5mbins = n(),
            across(where(is.numeric),  
                   ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
            .groups = "drop") 


# *** Calculating POC flux ***
pocFlux_UVP6 <- particle.conc %>% 
  select(station_year, reg.inuk, Depth_bin, Sampled_volume_L) %>% 
  mutate(ObsFlux = NA, ModelFlux = NA, 
         C1 = NA, alpha = NA, lambda = NA)

# This loop copies the script in Section 3 of processPocFluxFromUvp.m (Rufas et al. 2025). 
for (i in c(1:nrow(pocFlux_UVP6))) {
  a_par <- particle.conc[i, 7:27]
  a_vol <- uvp6_PAR$Sampled_volume_L[i]
  
  # No truncated power law model
  pocFlux_UVP6$ObsFlux[i] <- calculatePOCFlux(a_par, UVP6_sizebins_mid, 
                                              UVP6_sizebins_width)
  
  # With truncated power law model
  observedN <- round( a_par * a_vol )
  if(sum(observedN) > 0){
    tryCatch( {
      trunc <- calculateModelledPsd(observedN, a_vol, 
                                    UVP6_sizebins_width, UVP6_sizebins_mid )
      
      pocFlux_UVP6$ModelFlux[i] <- calculatePOCFlux(trunc$estimNbl,
                                                    UVP6_sizebins_mid,
                                                    UVP6_sizebins_width)
      pocFlux_UVP6$C1[i] <- trunc$C1
      pocFlux_UVP6$alpha[i] <- trunc$alpha
      pocFlux_UVP6$lambda[i] <- trunc$lambda
    },
    error = function(e){cat("ERROR: at i =", i, " ", 
                            conditionMessage(e), "\n")})
  } 
}

# For instances when the truncated power law model does not work, use the "observed"  value without the truncated power law model instead. This applies to  4 instances (< 0.1%)) and does not include the 200 m and 500 m depth bins of interest.
pocFluxErr_UVP6 <- pocFlux_UVP6 %>%
  filter(is.na(ModelFlux))
pocFlux_UVP6 <- pocFlux_UVP6 %>% 
  mutate(ModelFlux = if_else(is.na(ModelFlux),
                             ObsFlux, ModelFlux))
```

## Annual POC flux per subregion
```{r}
pocFlux_UVP6 <- pocFlux_UVP6 %>% 
  mutate(poc_mgC_m2_d = ModelFlux) %>% 
  # Estimate the annual flux (winter:summer conversion factor of 0.25)
  mutate(poc_gC_m2_yr = if_else(reg.inuk != "NarSt",
                                (poc_mgC_m2_d + 0.25*poc_mgC_m2_d)/2 *365 /1000,
                                (poc_mgC_m2_d*122 + 0.25*poc_mgC_m2_d*243) /1000))
  
# Extract POC flux at 100m, 200m, and 500m reference depths
pocFlux.ave.100 <- pocFlux_UVP6 %>% 
  filter(Depth_bin == 100)

pocFlux.ave.200 <- pocFlux_UVP6 %>% 
  filter(Depth_bin == 200)

pocFlux.ave.500 <- pocFlux_UVP6 %>%

ggplot() +

# Regional averages
```

## Calculate Martin's curve
```{r}
martin_params <- pocFlux_UVP6 %>%
  filter(station_year %notin% to_exclude_500) %>% 
  filter(ModelFlux > 0) %>%
  # Cap it at 600 m so all regions comparable
  filter(Depth_bin <= 600) %>% 
  group_by(reg.inuk) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    fit <- lm(log10(ModelFlux) ~ log10(Depth_bin / 100), data = .x)

    tibble(
      intercept_log10 = coef(fit)[1],
      slope = coef(fit)[2],
      F100 = 10^coef(fit)[1],
      b = -coef(fit)[2]
    )
  })

martin_pred <- pocFlux_UVP6 %>%
  filter(ModelFlux > 0, Depth_bin > 0) %>%
  group_by(reg.inuk) %>%
  summarise(
    Depth_bin = seq(
      min(Depth_bin, na.rm = TRUE),
      max(Depth_bin, na.rm = TRUE),
      length.out = 100
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(martin_params, by = "reg.inuk") %>%
  mutate(
    ModelFlux_pred = F100 * (Depth_bin / 100)^(-b)
  )

# Plot POC flux profile
ggplot(pocFlux_UVP6 %>% 
  filter(station_year %notin% to_exclude_500), 
  aes(x = Depth_bin, y = ModelFlux,
                         group = reg.inuk)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = station_year, color = reg.inuk), alpha = 0.3) +
   geom_line(
    data = martin_pred,
    aes(x = Depth_bin, y = ModelFlux_pred), 
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) +
  scale_x_reverse(limits = c(0, 600)) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_color_manual(values = clrs) +
  facet_wrap(~reg.inuk, scales = "free") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

```

## NBSS
```{r}
# *** Calculate the NBSS for selected depth bins ***
particle.biovolume <- particle.conc %>%
  filter(Depth_bin %in% c(100,200)) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(par_comp = list({
    a_par <- c_across(concentration_sc_22:concentration_sc_42)
    a_vol <- Sampled_volume_L
    observedN <- round(a_par * a_vol)

    trunc <- calculateModelledPsd(observedN,a_vol,
                                  UVP6_sizebins_width,UVP6_sizebins_mid)

    data.frame(Size_class_midpoint_mm = UVP6_sizebins_mid,
               sizebins_width = UVP6_sizebins_width,
               orig_conc = as.numeric(a_par),
               trunc_conc = trunc$estimNbl)})) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(station_year, reg.inuk, Depth_bin, n5mbins,
         Sampled_volume_L, par_comp) %>%
  unnest(par_comp) %>%
  mutate(sc_biovolume_mm3 = (4/3) * pi * (Size_class_midpoint_mm / 2)^3) %>%
  # Convert particle concentration to biovolume
  mutate(trunc_biov = trunc_conc * sc_biovolume_mm3) %>%
  # Remove size class with no particles
  filter(trunc_biov > 0) %>%
  # normalized biovolume by bin width
  mutate(normalized_biovolume = trunc_biov / sc_biovolume_mm3)

# Calculate the NBSS
particle.nbss <- particle.biovolume %>% 
  # Calculate the NBSS without > 5 mm particles (removing last 4 size bins wherein only <= 10 profiles have particle data)
  filter(Size_class_midpoint_mm < 4) %>% 
  mutate(log10_sizebin = log10(sc_biovolume_mm3),
         log10_normbiov = log10(normalized_biovolume)) %>% 
  group_by(station_year, Depth_bin, reg.inuk) %>% 
  summarise(nsizebins = n(),
            slope = coef(lm(log10_normbiov ~ log10_sizebin))[2],
            intercept = coef(lm(log10_normbiov ~ log10_sizebin))[1],
            r2 = summary(lm(log10_normbiov ~ log10_sizebin))$r.squared,
            p.value = summary(lm(log10_normbiov ~ log10_sizebin))$coefficients[2, 4],
            .groups = "drop")



ggplot(particle.nbss, aes(x = nsizebins, y = slope)) +
  geom_smooth() +
  geom_point(aes(color = reg.inuk)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = clrs)


# distribution of NBSS slopes
ggplot(particle.nbss, 
       aes(x = reg.inuk, y = slope, color = reg.inuk)) +
  geom_violin() +
   stat_summary(fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    size = 2) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_sdl,
    fun.args = list(mult = 1),
    geom = "errorbar",
    width = 0,
    color = "black" ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = clrs) +
  facet_wrap(~Depth_bin) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  ggtitle("NBSS slopes")


# distribution of NBSS intercepts
ggplot(particle.nbss, 
       aes(x = reg.inuk, y = intercept, color = reg.inuk)) +
  geom_violin() +
   stat_summary(fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    size = 2) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_sdl,
    fun.args = list(mult = 1),
    geom = "errorbar",
    width = 0,
    color = "black" ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = clrs) +
  facet_wrap(~Depth_bin) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  ggtitle("NBSS intercepts")
```

## test significant differences in NBSS slopes and intercepts between regions
Run ANOVA since slope and intercept distributions are generally normally distributed?
ANOVA and Krusk-wallis identify significant differences between subregions in slope but post hoc tests do not identify significant pairs.
ANOVA and Tukey tests for intercept identify TalIm, SanIm, and QikIk as significantly lower intercepts (i.e., lower total particle biovolume)
```{r}
df.for.stats <- particle.nbss %>% 
  filter(Depth_bin == 200)

# Parametric comparison
# *** Total (LPC + POC) Carbon flux ***
res.aov <- aov(slope ~ reg.inuk, data = df.for.stats) 
summary(res.aov)
res.tukey.slope <- as.data.frame(TukeyHSD(res.aov, "reg.inuk")$reg.inuk) %>% 
  filter(`p adj` < 0.025)

res.aov <- aov(intercept ~ reg.inuk, data = df.for.stats) 
summary(res.aov)
res.tukey.inter <- as.data.frame(TukeyHSD(res.aov, "reg.inuk")$reg.inuk)  %>% 
  filter(`p adj` < 0.025)
```

## Is there relationship between NBSS and POC flux?
- POC flux scales with intercept expectedly because intercept is a metric of total particle biomass.
- No apparent relationship between NBSS slope and POC flux
```{r}
comp.200 <- pocFlux.ave.200 %>% 
  left_join(particle.nbss %>% 
              filter(Depth_bin == 200) %>% 
              select(station_year, slope, intercept)) %>% 
  mutate(intercept_mm3 = 10^intercept)

ggplot(comp.200, aes(x = poc_mgC_m2_d, y = slope)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "gam", 
              formula = y ~ splines::bs(x, 3),
              color = "black") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  geom_point(aes(color = reg.inuk)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = clrs)


ggplot(comp.200, aes(x = poc_mgC_m2_d, y = intercept)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm",
              color = "black") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  geom_point(aes(color = reg.inuk)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = clrs)

```

# **** UVP5 ****

Data processing and POC flux analysis 
As an additional source of POC flux estimates, the compiled UVP5 data from Kiko et al. (2022) is used and similarly analyzed. The seasonal variation could be estimated since the historical sampling spans from April to October. 

Tasks: 
1. curate the samples further
2. assign regions to each sample
3. reorganize the script to match the UVP6 calculations


## Load and prep data
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
`%notin%` <- Negate(`%in%`)

load("data/uvp6_images_calculated_traits_20260321.RData")
rm(indiv_traits, volumes.df)

# Load data
load('C:/Sync/UVP5_Data_Kikoetal2022/Canadian_Arctic_subset.RData')

# Find nearest neighbor to UVP6 sample locations and use that as basis for the region assignment
# Convert to sf points
UVP5_sf <- UVP5_CA_Arctic_meta %>% 
  # minimum depth
  filter(Deepest_Bin >= 200) %>% 
  distinct(Profile, Cruise, Date_Time, Latitude, Longitude) %>% 
  st_as_sf(coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)

UVP6_sf <- Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
  select(sample_stationid_ed, region.inuktitut,
         Longitude = object_lon, Latitude = object_lat) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)

# Find nearest UVP6 point for each UVP5 point
nearest_idx <- st_nearest_feature(UVP5_sf, UVP6_sf)

# Assign region from nearest UVP6 station
UVP5_region <- UVP5_sf %>%
  mutate(
    nearest_stationid_ed = UVP6_sf$sample_stationid_ed[nearest_idx],
    region.inuktitut = UVP6_sf$region.inuktitut[nearest_idx],
    dist_m = st_distance(geometry, UVP6_sf$geometry[nearest_idx], 
                         by_element = TRUE) %>% 
      as.numeric()
  ) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  # convert the Qikiqtaluup Ikinga (Davis Strait) below 65N to Nunatsiavut
  mutate(region.inuktitut = 
           if_else(Latitude < 65 & 
                     region.inuktitut == "Qikiqtaaluup Ikinga\n(Davis Strait)",
         "Nunatsiavut Shelf\n(Labrador Shelf)", region.inuktitut)) %>% 
  mutate(region.inuktitut = factor(region.inuktitut,
                                   levels = levels(region_rename$region.inuktitut)))
  # remove some points in the fjords?

rm(UVP5_sf, UVP6_sf, nearest_idx)
```

## Curate the UVP5 profiles and establish size bins
```{r}
UVP5_CA_Arctic <- UVP5_CA_Arctic %>% 
  filter(Profile %in% UVP5_region$Profile) %>% 
  select(Profile, 
         Depth_5m = Pressure_dbar, Volume_L,
         concentration_128_161:concentration_13_16) 

UVP5_CA_Arctic_meta <- UVP5_CA_Arctic_meta %>% 
  filter(Profile %in% UVP5_region$Profile)


UVP5_sizebins_edges_mm <- c(0.128,0.161,0.203,0.256,0.323,0.406,0.512,0.645,0.813,1.02,1.29,1.63,2.05,2.58,3.25,4.1,5.16,6.5,8.19,10.3,13,16.4) 

UVP5_bins <- data.frame(Lower_limit_mm = UVP5_sizebins_edges_mm[1:21],
                   Upper_limit_mm = UVP5_sizebins_edges_mm[2:22]) %>% 
  # calculate bin width
  mutate(UVP6_sizebins_width = Upper_limit_mm - Lower_limit_mm) %>% 
  # calculate the midpoint as the geometric mean instead
  mutate(Size_class_midpoint_mm = sqrt(Lower_limit_mm * Upper_limit_mm))
  
UVP5_N_sizebins <- nrow(UVP5_bins)
# Get width of size bins
UVP5_sizebins_width <- UVP5_bins$UVP6_sizebins_width
# Get midpoints of size bins
UVP5_sizebins_mid <- UVP5_bins$Size_class_midpoint_mm
```

## POC Flux calculation
Only run if there are new calculations, else load the output file.
```{r, eval=FALSE}
pocFlux_UVP5 <- UVP5_CA_Arctic %>% 
  select(Profile,
         Depth_5m, Volume_L) %>% 
  mutate(ObsFlux = NA, ModelFlux = NA, C1 = NA, alpha = NA, lambda = NA)

for (i in c(1:nrow(pocFlux_UVP5))) {
  a_par <- UVP5_CA_Arctic[i, 4:24]
  a_vol <- UVP5_CA_Arctic$Volume_L[i]
  
   # No model
  pocFlux_UVP5$ObsFlux[i] <- calculatePOCFlux(a_par, UVP5_sizebins_mid,
                                              UVP5_sizebins_width)
  
  # With truncated power law model
  observedN <- round( a_par * a_vol )
  if(sum(observedN) > 0){
    tryCatch( {
      trunc <- calculateModelledPsd(observedN, a_vol, 
                                    UVP5_sizebins_width, UVP5_sizebins_mid )
      
      pocFlux_UVP5$ModelFlux[i] <- calculatePOCFlux(trunc$estimNbl,
                                                    UVP5_sizebins_mid,
                                                    UVP5_sizebins_width)
      pocFlux_UVP5$C1[i] <- trunc$C1
      pocFlux_UVP5$alpha[i] <- trunc$alpha
      pocFlux_UVP5$lambda[i] <- trunc$lambda
    },
    error = function(e){cat("ERROR: at i =", i, " ", 
                            conditionMessage(e), "\n")})
  }
}

pocFluxErr_UVP5 <- pocFlux_UVP5 %>%
  filter(is.na(ModelFlux))
pocFlux_UVP5 <- pocFlux_UVP5 %>% 
  mutate(ModelFlux = if_else(is.na(ModelFlux),
                             ObsFlux, ModelFlux))

# Export results to limit recalculations of this long loop
save(file = "data/UVP5_CA_Arctic_POCFLUX_results_20260329.RData",
     pocFlux_UVP5, UVP5_CA_Arctic, UVP5_CA_Arctic_meta, UVP5_region)
```

## Calculate regional integrated annual flux
```{r}
pocFlux_region_annual <- pocFlux_UVP5_profiles %>%   
   # consider only stations with at least 250m depth?
  filter(Depth_5m >= 150 & Depth_5m < 250) %>% 
  
  # average the flux for the 200 m layer
  group_by(Profile, region.inuktitut) %>%
  summarise(ModelFlux = mean(ModelFlux),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  # average values per region and month
  group_by(region.inuktitut) %>%
  summarise(ModelFlux_mean = mean(ModelFlux),
            ModelFlux_sd = sd(ModelFlux),
            nprofiles = n(),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(poc_model_365 = (ModelFlux_mean * 182.5 / 1000) + 
           (ModelFlux_mean * 0.25 * 182.5 / 1000)) 

ggplot(pocFlux_region_annual %>% 
         filter(region.inuktitut != "Nares Strait"), aes(x = region.inuktitut,
                                                         y = poc_model_365)) +
```

```{r}
load("data/UVP6_ECOPART_Data_20260320.RData")

#   scale_x_log10()

## Establish the size class bins and bin width
bins <- uvp6_par_cnames %>% 
  filter(grepl("concentration", AnnotatedColumnName)) %>% 
  filter(Lower_limit_um >= 128 & Lower_limit_um < 16400) %>% # to match the 0.14-16.88 mm size range in Kiko et al. (2017) and Bisson et al. (2022)
  
  # calculate the midpoint as the geometric mean instead
  mutate(Size_class_midpoint_mm = sqrt(Lower_limit_um * Upper_limit_um)/1000)
  

colStart <- which(uvp6_par_cnames$Lower_limit_um == 128)[1]-17
colEnd <- which(uvp6_par_cnames$Lower_limit_um == 13000)[1]-17

# number of bins
UVP6_N_sizebins <- nrow(bins)
# Get width of size bins
UVP6_sizebins_width <- bins$Size_class_width_mm
# Get midpoints of size bins
UVP6_sizebins_mid <- bins$Size_class_midpoint_mm



pocFlux_UVP6 <- uvp6_PAR %>% 
  select(sample_id, project,
         date, time, Depth_5m, Sampled_volume_L) %>% 
  mutate(ObsFlux = NA, ModelFlux = NA, 
         C1 = NA, alpha = NA, lambda = NA)

# This loop copies the script in Section 3 of processPocFluxFromUvp.m (Rufas et al. 2025). 
for (i in c(1:nrow(pocFlux_UVP6))) {
  a_par <- uvp6_PAR[i, colStart:colEnd]
  a_vol <- uvp6_PAR$Sampled_volume_L[i]
  
  # No truncated power law model
  pocFlux_UVP6$ObsFlux[i] <- calculatePOCFlux(a_par, UVP6_sizebins_mid, 
                                              UVP6_sizebins_width)
  
  # With truncated power law model
  observedN <- round( a_par * a_vol )
  if(sum(observedN) > 0){
    tryCatch( {
      trunc <- calculateModelledPsd(observedN, a_vol, 
                                    UVP6_sizebins_width, UVP6_sizebins_mid )
      
      pocFlux_UVP6$ModelFlux[i] <- calculatePOCFlux(trunc$estimNbl,
                                                    UVP6_sizebins_mid,
                                                    UVP6_sizebins_width)
      pocFlux_UVP6$C1[i] <- trunc$C1
      pocFlux_UVP6$alpha[i] <- trunc$alpha
      pocFlux_UVP6$lambda[i] <- trunc$lambda
    },
    error = function(e){cat("ERROR: at i =", i, " ", 
                            conditionMessage(e), "\n")})
  } 
}

# For instances when the truncated power law model does not work, use the "observed"  value without the truncated power law model instead. This applies to about 32 instances (< 0.1%)) and does not include the 200 m and 500 m depth bins of interest.
pocFluxErr_UVP6 <- pocFlux_UVP6 %>%
  filter(is.na(ModelFlux))
pocFlux_UVP6 <- pocFlux_UVP6 %>% 
  mutate(ModelFlux = if_else(is.na(ModelFlux),
                             ObsFlux, ModelFlux))

# Export results
save(pocFlux_UVP6, bins,
file = "data/POC_flux_UVP6_confident_20260329.RData")
```

# Particle size distributions
Are there regional differences in the NBSS? Are there depth differences? What are the characteristics of the marine snow in regions where POC>LPC flux?
```{r}
# For Station_year and region metadata
load("data/uvp6_images_calculated_traits_20260321.RData")
rm(indiv_traits, region_rename, volumes.df)
clrs <- c("firebrick","#FF6800","#FFB300","forestgreen", "blue1","purple2","#F6768E")

# Outlier profiles to exclude
to_exclude_200 <- c("AC20 2023","NaresW23 2023","NaresE23 2023",
                "RA38 2024", "RA06 2024", "RA07 2024", "RA08 2024", "RA31 2024",
                "RA42 2024", "RA43 2024", "RA73 2024", 
                "Kangalasiorvik Shelf 2024",
                "TCA-QFA1 2024", "de500 2021",
                "keb_S05 2024","RA72 2024","RA02 2024","RA52 2024")

depths_2_extract <- data.frame(Depth_5m = c(92.5,97.5,102.5,107.5,
                                            192.5,197.5,202.5,207.5,
                                            492.5,497.5,502.5,507.5),
                               Depth_bin = c(100,100,100,100,
                                             200,200,200,200,
                                             500,500,500,500))
bins <- uvp6_par_cnames %>% 
  filter(grepl("biovolume", AnnotatedColumnName)) %>% 
  filter(Lower_limit_um >= 128 & Lower_limit_um < 16400) %>%
  # calculate the midpoint as the geometric mean instead
  mutate(Size_class_midpoint_mm = sqrt(Lower_limit_um * Upper_limit_um)/1000)
  

# Apply truncated power law model and calculate the NBSS from this (the same in the POC flux calculation but based on particle concentration)

# Get width of size bins
UVP6_sizebins_width <- bins$Size_class_width_mm
# Get midpoints of size bins
UVP6_sizebins_mid <- bins$Size_class_midpoint_mm

particle.biov <- uvp6_PAR[, c(1,6,7,12:32)] %>% 
  # Extract the 100, 200, and 500 m +- 10m depth bins
  left_join(depths_2_extract, by = join_by(Depth_5m)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Depth_bin)) %>% 
  left_join(Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
              select(sample_id, station_year, reg.inuk), 
            by = join_by(sample_id)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(station_year)) %>% 
  filter(station_year %notin% to_exclude_200) %>% 
  # average by depth bin and station_year
  group_by(station_year, Depth_bin,reg.inuk) %>% 
  summarise(n5mbins = n(),
            across(where(is.numeric),  
                   ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
            .groups = "drop") 

# Calculate the truncated power law model concentration on each row
particle.biov_long <- particle.biov %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(par_comp = list({
    a_par <- c_across(concentration_sc_22:concentration_sc_42)
    a_vol <- Sampled_volume_L
    observedN <- round(a_par * a_vol)
    
    trunc <- calculateModelledPsd(observedN,a_vol,
                                  UVP6_sizebins_width,UVP6_sizebins_mid)
    
    data.frame(Size_class_midpoint_mm = UVP6_sizebins_mid,
               sizebins_width = UVP6_sizebins_width,
               orig_conc = as.numeric(a_par),
               trunc_conc = trunc$estimNbl)})) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(station_year, reg.inuk, Depth_bin, n5mbins, 
         Sampled_volume_L, par_comp) %>%
  unnest(par_comp) %>% 
  
  mutate(sc_biovolume_mm3 = (4/3) * pi * (Size_class_midpoint_mm / 2)^3) %>% 
  # Convert particle concentration to biovolume
  mutate(trunc_biov = trunc_conc * sc_biovolume_mm3) %>% 
  # Remove size class with no particles
  filter(trunc_biov > 0) %>% 
  # normalized biovolume by bin width
  mutate(normalized_biovolume = trunc_biov / sc_biovolume_mm3) 

# Calculate the NBSS
particle.nbss.trunc <- particle.biov_long %>% 
  # Calculate the NBSS without > 5 mm particles (removing last 4 size bins wherein only <= 10 profiles have particle data)
  filter(Size_class_midpoint_mm < 5) %>% 
  mutate(log10_sizebin = log10(sc_biovolume_mm3),
         log10_normbiov = log10(normalized_biovolume)) %>% 
  group_by(station_year, Depth_bin, reg.inuk) %>% 
  summarise(nsizebins = n(),
            slope = coef(lm(log10_normbiov ~ log10_sizebin))[2],
            intercept = coef(lm(log10_normbiov ~ log10_sizebin))[1],
            r2 = summary(lm(log10_normbiov ~ log10_sizebin))$r.squared,
            p.value = summary(lm(log10_normbiov ~ log10_sizebin))$coefficients[2, 4],
            .groups = "drop")


# Which depth bins has the most zeros?
ggplot(particle.biov_long %>% 
         filter(Depth_bin == 200) %>% 
         filter(normalized_biovolume > 0) %>% 
         filter(station_year %notin% to_exclude_200), 
       aes(x = as.factor(Size_class_midpoint_mm))) +
  geom_histogram(stat = "count") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))


ggplot(particle.nbss.trunc, aes(x = intercept, y = slope)) +
  geom_smooth() +
  geom_point() 


```

## Calculate martin's b
```{r}
load("data/POC_flux_UVP6_confident_20260329.RData")

martins.curve <- pocFlux_UVP6 %>% 
  left_join(Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
              select(sample_id, reg.inuk, station_year)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(station_year)) %>% 
  filter(station_year %notin% to_exclude_200) %>% 
  filter(Depth_5m > 100)

martin_params <- martins.curve %>%
  filter(ModelFlux > 0) %>%
  group_by(station_year, reg.inuk) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(
    model = map(
      data,
      ~ lm(log(ModelFlux) ~ log(Depth_5m / 100), data = .x)
    ),
    
    coefs = map(model, coef)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    intercept_log = map_dbl(coefs, 1),
    slope = map_dbl(coefs, 2),
    # Martin parameters
    martin_b = -slope,
    F100 = exp(intercept_log)
  ) %>%
  select(
    station_year,
    reg.inuk,
    F100,
    martin_b
  )

ggplot(martin_params, aes(x = martin_b)) +
  geom_density()


ggplot(martins.curve %>% 
  filter(station_year == "D4 2023"), 
  aes(x = ModelFlux, y = Depth_5m)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_y_reverse()
```
